changes: New: Ghost Cut, a microlooper on FX2. GRAB loops a tempo-synced piece of the track; let go and the track fades back.
LEN from 1/64 to 1/4 of a note at the project's tempo, RATE from a quarter speed to almost four times.
ENG GRAIN plays the loop at PTCH (±24 semitones) while RATE only changes its speed; GRN sets the grain length.
CAPT loops the last LEN, the next LEN, or the ring as it was; DIR plays forwards, backwards or back and forth.
Not yet tried on a unit.
